title: Rule
description: A rule about drift. The controller drops matching drift at intake (D-092). Only a human approves a Plan that changes a Rule (D-099).

name.description: Unique per kind. Lower case letters, digits, '-' and '.'.

action.description: What the rule does. 'ignore': matching drift opens no Issue. A Plan still shows and applies the difference.

target.description: Name of a Target, or '*' for every target, also future ones.

resource.description: Exact resource id 'type:key', for example 'file:/etc/motd'. No patterns.

attrs.description: Attributes that the rule covers. Default: every attribute of the resource.
